scenes.title: GrowthOps OS
scenes.sub: Ad platforms, the CRM and the bank each report a different revenue figure. **Which one is right?**

scenes.caption: Ad platforms claim **$3.72M**. The CRM books **$3.32M**. The bank collected **$3.06M**. Which number is right?
Every step from CRM bookings to cash is computed, so nothing is left unexplained: the residual is **$0**.
Meta reports **7.3×** return on ad spend. On the cash the business actually kept, it is **3.3×**.
Lead quality fell from **29.8%** to **20.4%**. The detector caught it within three days and traced **92%** of the drop to one new campaign.
That campaign, **meta_broad_v17**, lifted leads **61%** while their quality fell.
A seven-page Power BI report generated from a specification, with **215** documented DAX measures. This summary is written in DAX.
The Excel workbook is formulas over the same dbt marts, and reaches the same answer on its own: **$309,900** net cash, as in Power BI.

scenes.title: growthops-os — real output, recorded for this video
scenes.caption: Tests hold every claim: both bridges tie exactly, the detector finds each planted incident, and the workbook reconciles.

scenes.cta: Download the workbook and compare it with the Power BI report.
